## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure 1W: -3.36% | 1M: +2.01% with notable dispersion; NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) and INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) while ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) and INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +7.90%). News confirms pockets of AI demand (ASML/ACN headlines) but broader tech weakness and headline-driven selling create tactical, not broad, longs.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials 1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.45% is weak with SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) and C BELOW TREND (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.65%), but Visa ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +9.22%) show bifurcation between payments and banks. Net: Financials are not leading and add to the RISK-OFF backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is constructive 1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.24% with UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +7.58%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.44%) while JNJ is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -6.00%). Sector strength supports the defensive tilt within the RISK-OFF regime.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor defensive/quality names and selective cyclicals showing clear momentum: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%), MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +4.67%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%). Reduce exposure to beaten-up Tech and banks showing trend breaks (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%)); style: defensive/value tilt.
